description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.2-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed featured artists no longer splitting with default separators
- Fixed sidebar rows shifting during drags
- Fixed playlist pill flickering during drag
- Fixed album page artist name disappearing with accent color
- Fixed pause with fades ending in a volume burst
- Fixed Linux AppImage audio dropouts on first play/idle
- Fixed Playlists grid flickering between tile sizes
- Fixed dropped files clearing from queue on library change
- Fixed island title opening album for non-library files
- Fixed Liquid Glass menus/tooltips being too transparent
- Fixed mini player going off-screen when switching styles
- Fixed metadata panel showing wrong artwork size
- Fixed album cover picking wrong track's cover on scan
Added
- Added Liquid drag-to-reorder for queue, playlists, sidebar
- Added drag card preview (artwork, title, artist) while dragging
- Added Queue selection (Ctrl/Shift+click, Delete, Ctrl+A, Esc)
- Added Queue right-click remove selection
- Added Mini player button on player island
- Added Frosted Background toggle for mini player
- Added Lyrics translation and romanization support
- Added Show Translations/Romanization/Background Vocals toggles
- Added Per-track covers (differing embedded covers per song)
- Added Cover Flow redesign (15 cards, no overlap, straight line)
Improved
- Improved Album page colour picking (band sampling, tone-down neons)
- Improved Album page layout (full screen colour, facts at bottom)
- Improved Other Versions/More By section (hidden when empty)
- Improved mini player opacity slider for Pill/Sleeve designs
- Improved Cover Flow captions and glass background
Full Changelog: v1.5.1...v1.5.2
